correctness.rationale: Separable Wedderburn–Malcev splitting and K⊗FqK≅∏σK decompose J into K^{kσ} with σ-twisted right action. For a residue-generating r-tuple, N=B∩J is a K-bimodule; an algebra section modulo N defines σ-derivations. Ordinary derivations of finite separable fields vanish; for nonidentity σ, every σ-derivation is t(σ(a)−a). Therefore N_id is spanned by r independent uniform radical vectors, while N_σ for σ≠id is spanned by r−1 adjusted vectors b_i−(σ(a_i)−a_i)/(σ(a_j)−a_j)b_j. This linear transformation is invertible, separately by σ, making all ranks independent conditional on residues; the law is independent of the particular generating residue tuple. Gaussian-binomial rank counts give the displayed distribution. Möbius inversion over subfields gives the exact residue-generation probability and product full-generation formula; positivity iff nσ≥kσ yields the minimal positive r, including kσ=0 and m=1 boundaries. Independent brute-force F2 algebra closure verified all r≤3 and k_id≤3; examined original F4 closure checker for twisted examples.
residual_risks: Finite closure tests support small cases only; the all-q, all-multiplicity theorem follows from separability, twisted-derivation identity and exact rank counting.
Conditional law requires the residue image be the full field K; no law for arbitrary proper residue subfields is claimed.
